title: Developments in Medium of trade
status: draft: written 18 Nov 2026 offline for Grade 7 Social Studies; not yet checked by a CBC Social Studies teacher; not loaded by the live tutor
notes: Play a barter market in class with no money, then repeat with tokens. Facts: cowries, beads, salt, iron hoes and cattle were used before coins; the rupee and then the East African shilling came with colonial rule.

skills.key_step: The child compares barter with money and gives the problems of barter.

floor.prerequisite: Names ways people depend on each other.
floor.question: Give one way people depend on each other.

steps: Find the problem: both must want what the other has.

board.do: Write: "I have a goat. I need salt. The salt seller wants a pot."
Wait for "he does not want my goat".
Write the problem: double coincidence of wants.

misconceptions.ask: What is a problem of barter trade?
misconceptions.repair: Ask Nyambura how she can buy cloth if the seller does not want her maize.
Ask what Mwangi gives the fisherman for fish when he has no coins.

misconceptions.ask: Why was it hard to trade a cow for salt in barter?
misconceptions.repair: Try trading a cow for a small bag of salt in role play.

misconceptions.ask: Why does a shopkeeper accept a 100-shilling note?
misconceptions.repair: Ask what a note is worth on an island where no one accepts it.

checks.question: What is barter trade?
checks.answer: swapping goods for goods without money

checks.question: Give one problem of barter.
checks.answer: any of: both must want what the other has, goods hard to divide, hard to value, hard to store and carry

skills.key_step: The child says what was used before coins, why money came, and what it changed.

floor.question: Give one problem of barter.
floor.answer: both must want what the other has

board.do: Draw a line from long ago to today.

board.say: What was used as money here?

board.do: Wait for cowries, beads, salt or iron hoes.
Add coins, notes and mobile money.

misconceptions.ask: What was used as money before coins in many parts of Africa?
misconceptions.repair: Ask what Kenyans on the coast used to trade for goods long ago.

misconceptions.ask: Which is a bad effect of introducing money?
misconceptions.repair: Ask what happens to a person who borrows money and cannot pay.

misconceptions.ask: When did mobile money begin in Kenya?
misconceptions.repair: Put cowries, rupees, shillings and mobile money on a timeline.

misconceptions.ask: How did colonial taxes push people to earn money?
misconceptions.repair: Explain the hut tax and why it needed cash.

checks.question: What was used as money before coins in many parts of Africa?
checks.answer: cowrie shells, beads, salt, iron hoes or cattle

checks.question: Give one bad effect of the introduction of money.
checks.answer: debt or a gap between rich and poor
